class.name: DSContext
class.brief_description: Core singleton manager for DirectStorage hardware acceleration and fallback backends in Godot.
class.description: [DSContext] manages the lifecycle of the Microsoft DirectStorage factory, memory queues, staging buffers, and cross-platform I/O fallback backends. It provides batch request submission and cancellation for NVMe streaming pipelines.

method.name: cancel_requests_with_tag
method.description: Cancels all enqueued read requests whose cancellation tag matches [param tag].

method.name: enqueue_request
method.description: Enqueues a [DSRequest] object into the active DirectStorage/fallback I/O queue. Returns [code]true[/code] if enqueued successfully.

method.name: flush_batch
method.description: Flushes and submits all enqueued requests in the queue to the DirectStorage runtime or fallback worker threadpool.

method.name: get_active_backend_name
method.description: Returns the name of the active I/O backend ([code]"Win32DirectStorage"[/code] or [code]"SoftwareFallback"[/code]).

method.name: initialize_ds
method.description: Initializes DirectStorage hardware queues and staging buffers. Returns [code]true[/code] if initialized successfully.

method.name: is_d3d12_backend
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if Godot is running with the Direct3D 12 rendering driver.

method.name: is_supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the current OS platform supports DirectStorage.

method.name: shutdown_ds
method.description: Shuts down DirectStorage queues, releases COM interfaces, and cleans up active backend resources.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], forces DirectStorage runtime to perform CPU decompression instead of GPU decompression shaders.
